newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SSAB sells lime plant to SMA.
newsitem.headline: SSAB sells lime plant to SMA.

text.p: Swedish steel group SSAB said on Friday its unit SSAB Oxelosund AB sold a lime plant to Swedish group SMA Svenska Mineral AB.
"In connection with this, a longterm delivery deal for burnt lime has been struck," SSAB said in a statement.
"The deal enables a significantly larger capacity utilisation and will increase productivity to the benefit of both parties."
The plant is one of Sweden's largest lime mills with a total annual capacity of 150,000 tonnes and 11 employees.
SMA Mineral AB is one of the leading companies within lime and dolomite in the Nordic region.
